subject: humanities
passage: Although Ludwig van Beethoven had lost nearly all of his hearing by the time he completed his Ninth Symphony in ______ the work is among the most ambitious he ever attempted: its final movement adds vocal soloists and a full chorus to the orchestra, an unusual choice for a symphony at the time. Scholars generally credit the achievement to an inner ear trained by decades of composing, which let him imagine sounds he could no longer hear.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The first sentence begins with "Although," so everything up to "in 1824" is a dependent clause, and "the work is among the most ambitious he ever attempted" is the main clause. A dependent clause that comes first is joined to the main clause with a comma.
explanation.A: Correct. A comma correctly links the introductory "Although" clause to the main clause.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A semicolon must join two independent clauses, but the "Although" clause is dependent.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A period would leave "Although Ludwig van Beethoven … in 1824" as a sentence fragment.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete independent clause, and the "Although" clause is not one.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
